decisions.reason: The modular plant concept showed a strong quantified customer saving, but it got no website visibility in 2024, so it stays open as a low-cost option while its value is still uncertain.
The single slow-speed shredder may be absorbed by the new multi-model slow-speed shredder line E, but it still sits close to the core business and costs little to keep for now.
As the flagship modular line central to the firm's strategic direction, it warrants continued commitment despite lower website visibility in 2024.
The trommel screen is a low-cost extension of a core category in a growing market, and no negative evidence justifies abandoning it.
The new slow-speed shredder line has its own page and is core to the firm's offer, so its uncertainty is still resolving and keeping it costs little.
The recently launched spiral shaft screen line has a dedicated page and extends the screening portfolio, so the option should stay open while results emerge.
